91:     return current();
92:   }

96:     if (sentenceStarts.length > 0) {
97:       currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
98:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
99:     } else { // there are no sentences; both the first and last positions are the begin index
100:       currentSentence = 0;
101:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
102:     }
103:     return current();
104:   }
105: 
106:   @Override
107:   public int next() {
108:     if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex() || 0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
109:       return DONE;
110:     } else if (currentSentence < sentenceStarts.length - 1) {
111:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[++currentSentence]);
112:       return current();
113:     } else {
114:       return last();
115:     }
116:   }

118:   @Override
119:   public int following(int pos) {
120:     if (pos < text.getBeginIndex() || pos > text.getEndIndex()) {
121:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset out of bounds");
122:     } else if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
123:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
124:       return DONE;
125:     } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[sentenceStarts.length - 1]) {
126:       // this conflicts with the javadocs, but matches actual behavior (Oracle has a bug in

129:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
130:       currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
131:       return DONE;
132:     } else { // there are at least two sentences
133:       currentSentence = (sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2; // start search from the middle
134:       moveToSentenceAt(pos, 0, sentenceStarts.length - 2);
135:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[++currentSentence]);
136:       return current();
137:     }
138:   }

140:   /** Binary search over sentences */
141:   private void moveToSentenceAt(int pos, int minSentence, int maxSentence) {
142:     if (minSentence != maxSentence) {
143:       if (pos < sentenceStarts[currentSentence]) {
144:         int newMaxSentence = currentSentence - 1;
145:         currentSentence = minSentence + (currentSentence - minSentence) / 2;
146:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, minSentence, newMaxSentence);
147:       } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1]) {
148:         int newMinSentence = currentSentence + 1;
149:         currentSentence = maxSentence - (maxSentence - currentSentence) / 2;
150:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, newMinSentence, maxSentence);

44:         "And finally, sentence number 3 has 8 words."
45:       };

55:   public void testThreeSentences() throws Exception {

66:   private CharacterIterator getCharArrayIterator(String text) {

78:           }
79:         };

81:     return charArrayIterator;
82:   }

97:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[2], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
98:     end = bi.current();
99:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[1], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
100:     end = bi.current();
101:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[0], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
102:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.previous());
103:     assertEquals(0, bi.current());

105:     assertEquals(59, bi.following(39));

107:     assertEquals(31, bi.following(30));
108: 
109:     assertEquals(0, bi.preceding(57));
110:     assertEquals(0, bi.preceding(58));
111:     assertEquals(31, bi.preceding(59));
112: 
113:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
114:     assertEquals(59, bi.next(2));
115:     assertEquals(0, bi.next(-2));
116:   }

128:     assertEquals(start, bi.first());
129:     int current = bi.current();
130:     assertEquals(bi.getText().getEndIndex(), bi.next());
